title: Repair mobile menu label contract
detail: Plain-text menu buttons conflict with the controller’s required child span. First destination selection can fail.

title: Move the mobile drawer below the header
detail: The Shop row at y106–168 is underneath the header at y103.5–175.5 in the sampled phone layout.

title: Keep Enlarge outside the image mask
detail: The arched container clips the control; its center does not hit the button.

title: Unify pack facts across surfaces
detail: D3+K2 says 60 softgels while its FAQ and bag say the count is pending/unconfirmed.

title: Map sample policy copy by exact section ID
detail: Delivery charges and failed-delivery sections receive a delivery-time estimate.

title: Align trust headings with demo feedback
detail: Real-people wording and C’s NOTHING MADE UP treatment contradict fictional feedback.

title: Increase bag-count contrast
detail: The sampled light count on white is approximately 1.22:1.

title: Reconcile public contact status
detail: About says details will be published later; Contact and footers already show direct channels.

title: Label missing rear-label imagery directly
detail: An Approved label image heading contains pack-directed text rather than an image or a clear unavailable state.

title: Choose one primary customer direction
detail: Refine B as the flagship candidate and E as the quieter alternative, then test them with the same content.

title: Identify supplements and expose Shop in chapter one
detail: The scenery and cup dominate before the product category and shopping action become clear.

title: Shorten the mandatory cinematic introduction
detail: Offer a direct catalogue path throughout the opening story.

title: Bring the mobile purchase path higher
detail: The sampled Add to bag controls start around y988–1159 at 390×844.

title: Enlarge meaningful metadata and motion labels
detail: Several homepage labels compute to 6–10 px in the mobile sample.

title: Strengthen display strokes and functional hierarchy
detail: Ultra-light headlines are less robust on small screens; use normal-weight functional text.

title: Define reading, display and metadata roles
detail: Core and campaign font roles should be explicit, including the About typography explanation.

title: Create semantic tokens beside product colors
detail: Keep product identity separate from warning, error, success and selected states.

title: Build a complete accurate gallery for every SKU
detail: Supply readable rear labels, format/scale imagery and consistent real-world product photographs.

title: Publish approved facts for all seven products
detail: Exact amounts, complete ingredients, directions, suitability and cautions must come from genuine records.

title: Clarify the additional omega-3 ingredient
detail: Product identity should not conceal a third named ingredient behind the short title.

title: Separate total oil and active amounts
detail: Use the approved EPA/DHA, form, source and allergen facts; no amounts are proposed by this audit.

title: Resolve formulation and format information
detail: Use the approved chew base, active form/amount, sweeteners and flavor, distinct from gummies.

title: Make the pincode tool describe its actual capability
detail: It checks format rather than serviceability or an arrival date.

title: Put available evidence before general explanation
detail: Standards should show actual record scope/status first, then the educational explanation.

title: Bring lot input higher on phones
detail: The long introduction and seven product chips push the input down.

title: Replace fictional origin/facility entries for release
detail: Only supplied and verified records can support actual sourcing claims.

title: Give About and Story distinct purposes
detail: About should explain the business now; Story should explain a specific genuine origin.

title: Replace absent-people promises with genuine material
detail: Names, roles and portraits should be supplied before a prominent Meet the people route promises them.

title: Simplify the hub’s first choices
detail: Use products, labels and evidence as the primary paths; keep the extended index secondary.

title: Show the article takeaway before the long contents list
detail: Mobile metadata, three actions and the full contents occupy the initial screen.

title: Unify product, guide, glossary and help search
detail: Global omega search returned two products and a forms guide, without the dedicated omega guide in that result set.

title: Complete and identify genuine specialist review
detail: The current guides openly say they have not yet had specialist review.

title: Use compact checkout and account introductions
detail: Bring fields, order status and actions higher; use literal progress labels.

title: Reconcile delivery, discount and policy summaries
detail: One rule should drive bag, product disclosures, checkout and policies.

title: Clarify what channel Available means
detail: Distinguish a direct link, staffed support and the local case function.

title: Load only the required theme and page modules
detail: The shell references 38 stylesheets and 38 scripts, about 2.36 MB raw before further dependencies/media.

title: Defer unselected 3D models
detail: The selected model is followed by the remaining six; seven GLBs total about 8.7 MB on disk.

title: Complete keyboard, screen-reader and reflow checks
detail: A route sweep and computed-style scan are not an accessibility conformance audit.

title: Collapse footer groups on phones
detail: Sampled product footers are roughly 1100–1530 px tall.

title: Replace repeated curiosity copy with useful distinctions
detail: Every section should answer a different shopper question.

title: Explain or rename Recommended sorting
detail: Featured is clearer if order is editorial; seven SKUs do not require elaborate discovery machinery.

title: Give example pairings a useful comparison purpose
detail: Current pairings have no approved savings or joint-use recommendation.

title: Use one meaningful moving focal point at a time
detail: Motion should explain selection, a product detail or feedback; keep a useful static view.

title: Validate saved and device reduced-motion behavior
detail: Source supports it; exercise every scene and navigation in a dedicated preference pass.

title: Connect the imaginative world to the visible bottle
detail: The opening cup/scenery should help visitors recognize the actual category.

title: Bring a product composition higher
detail: Strengthen product appeal alongside the clean color index and typography.

title: Add restrained warmth to the reference system
detail: Use selective product color and human imagery without losing reading clarity.

title: Prioritize exceptions, filters and readable record summaries
detail: Safety cases and withdrawn lots should stand out; mobile tables need useful drill-down.

title: Separate reviewer controls from the customer release
detail: Keep the preview selector for review; a selected customer direction needs its own clean entry.

title: Prepare accurate metadata and indexing
detail: Preview noindex is intentional. Set canonicals, sitemap and accurate structured data for the intended release.

title: Measure real-device performance and user tasks
detail: Use Core Web Vitals, comprehension, task success and errors rather than visual votes alone.
